evidence.promqlTests:
fuzzy_compare: true
evaluation_interval: 15s
tests:
- interval: 15s
  input_series:
  - series: http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo",pod="podinfo-a",status="200"}
    values: 0+1500x12
  - series: http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo",pod="podinfo-b",status="200"}
    values: 0+3000x12
  - series: http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo",pod="podinfo-c",status="200"}
    values: 0+13500x12
  - series: http_requests_total{namespace="unrelated",service="podinfo",pod="podinfo-other",status="200"}
    values: 0+90000x12
  promql_expr_test:
  - expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",pod=~"podinfo-.*"}[2m]))
      by (namespace,pod)
    eval_time: 3m
    exp_samples:
    - labels: '{namespace="scaling-demo",pod="podinfo-a"}'
      value: 100
    - labels: '{namespace="scaling-demo",pod="podinfo-b"}'
      value: 200
    - labels: '{namespace="scaling-demo",pod="podinfo-c"}'
      value: 900
  - expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo"}[2m]))
    eval_time: 3m
    exp_samples:
    - labels: '{}'
      value: 1200
- interval: 15s
  input_series: []
  promql_expr_test:
  - expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo"}[2m]))
    eval_time: 3m
    exp_samples: []
- interval: 15s
  input_series:
  - series: http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo",pod="podinfo-zero",status="200"}
    values: 0+0x12
  promql_expr_test:
  - expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="scaling-demo",service="podinfo"}[2m]))
    eval_time: 3m
    exp_samples:
    - labels: '{}'
      value: 0
